<div class="changelog-entry"><span class="ptag pgf">PGF</span> Create Filters Framework — the generic, schema-driven filter framework in the KMP <code>pgf/feature/filters</code> module: <code>FiltersModel</code>, <code>FiltersModelBuilder</code>, and the filter type hierarchy (Status, Members, Date, Hierarchy, Text, Input, Toggle, NumericRange), shared across iOS and Android for both Filters Panel and Quick Filters.
